📋 **{quest}**

**{label}** , complete this activity, then come back to continue.
quests.boss_ko: ❌ Your pet is K.O.! Feed it first.

boss_league.description: Challenge the Boss League and prove your pet's strength!
boss_league.step0_intro: 🏟️ The Boss League awaits! Five powerful bosses stand between you and the title of Champion. Your pet must be strong , each victory earns rare rewards. Step into the arena!
boss_league.step10_victory: 🔥🎉 **The Phoenix bows!** You are crowned the **Boss League Champion!** The **Phoenix Crest** and the legendary **Boss Trophy** are yours! Your name will be remembered forever!
boss_league.step1_battle:
⚔️ **Boss 1/5. The Boulder**
A massive stone golem blocks your path. Its rocky hide deflects weak attacks. Strike hard and fast!
boss_league.step2_victory: 🎉 The Boulder crumbles! You earned a **Spark Shard** , a fragment of pure lightning energy. One down, four to go!
boss_league.step3_battle:
⚔️ **Boss 2/5 , Stoneheart**
A living statue wielding a crystallized heart of solid rock. It drains the life force of anything that gets too close.
boss_league.step4_victory: 🎉 Stoneheart shatters! You claim the **Stone Heart** , a dense core pulsing with ancient power. The crowd roars!
boss_league.step5_battle:
⚔️ **Boss 3/5 , Stormbringer**
A winged beast crackling with Tempest energy. It commands lightning and moves faster than the eye can track.
boss_league.step6_victory: 🎉 The storm clears! You seize the **Storm Core**, a swirling sphere of captured gale-force winds. Halfway there!
boss_league.step7_battle:
⚔️ **Boss 4/5 , Abyssal Kraken**
A colossal tentacled horror from the deep ocean trenches. Its grip is crushing, its reach immense.
boss_league.step8_victory: 🎉 The Kraken retreats to the depths! You salvage the **Abyss Pearl** , a dark orb containing the light of a drowned star.
boss_league.step9_battle:
⚔️ **Boss 5/5. The Phoenix Emperor**
The final challenge. A majestic, burning phoenix whose flames can reduce steel to ash. Only the strongest may face it.
boss_league.title: Boss League

irian_training.description: Irian offers to train your pet so it can defeat the Vault Guardian.
irian_training.step0_intro:
You limp back to the docks, your pet bruised and defeated. Irian is waiting by the water, arms crossed.

"That old machine doesn't pull its punches. I saw the whole fight."

He kneels beside your pet and looks it over. "Your pet isn't weak. It's untrained. Food builds strength. The hunt builds instincts. Do both, and that Guardian won't know what hit it."

He hands you a small pouch of credits. "Start with the bowl. `!pets` — feed your companion. I'll be here when you're done."
irian_training.step1_feed: Goal: Feed your pet 3 times using `!pets`.
irian_training.step2_feed_dialogue:
Irian watches the feeding with a satisfied nod.

"Good. A fed pet is a strong pet — every meal makes it tougher."

He points toward the treeline. "Now for the second lesson. Instincts are earned in the wild, not at the bowl. Take your pet hunting. `!hunt` until you've both earned your keep."
irian_training.step3_hunt: Goal: Hunt 3 times using `!hunt` — your pet gains XP with every victory.
irian_training.step4_level_req: Goal: Raise your pet to **level 10** — feed it, hunt with it, and it will grow stronger.
irian_training.step5_reward:
Irian studies your pet with the eye of a veteran. Then, for the first time, he smiles.

"Level 10. Now *that's* a hunter's companion."

He packs a bundle of provisions for the road — warrior's stew, stonebread, wind-touched berries. "Feed it these before the fight. Every bit of strength counts."

He claps your shoulder. "Now go. Show that Guardian what a trained pet can do."
irian_training.title: The Mentor's Lesson

quests.boss_lose_taunt: 💀 The boss laughs at you: 'Is that all you got? Train your pet and come back!'
quests.boss_no_pet: ❌ You must have an active pet to fight the boss.

chronicler_legend.description: The Chronicler hands you an empty book — and asks you to fill its last page.
chronicler_legend.step0_intro:
The Chronicler closes the book that never runs out of pages — and hands you an empty one.

"The book is not running out of pages. I am. Every legend in this village is ink from my quill, and I have never once written my own."

He looks at you, and for the first time, his voice is quiet. "I am the last Chronicler. It is time to be the last page instead."

He presses the empty book into your hands. "Fill it. Descend into the Undercroft — let the dark read you. Send your pet into the wastes beyond the gates. Best the strongest foe the arena has. Then bring the ink back to me, and I will write what I never dared."
chronicler_legend.step1_delve: Goal: Descend into the Undercroft 3 times using `/delve` — let the dark read you.
chronicler_legend.step2_expedition: Goal: Send your pet on 2 expeditions using `/expedition` — gather the ink of the wastes.
chronicler_legend.step3_boss:
⚔️ **The strongest foe in the arena**
Best the champion of the boss league with `!boss fight` — only the strongest may claim the final ink.
chronicler_legend.step4_outro:
You place the book on the Chronicler's desk. When he opens it, the pages are full — not with your legend, but with his: Thorek's hammer. Elara's empty bed. Irian's bell. Vance's ledger. The Whisper's mirror.

He reads in silence for a long moment. Then he closes the book and hands it back.

"The book is yours now. Every legend needs a hand to hold it."

He steps outside into the morning. "I'll be outside, seeing what the world looks like when I'm not writing it down."
chronicler_legend.title: The Last Page

lost_warden.description: A ghostly guardian in the Undercroft asks you to find what he lost.
lost_warden.step0_intro:
The Lost Warden looks at you with eyes like cooling embers.

"You can see me. That is rarer than you know."

He gestures down the passage. "I was the last guard of a vault older than the village. I gave my word, then I gave my life, and now I give only this: a promise I cannot keep alone."

"I lost something below — the key to what I swore to protect. Descend. Let the depths show you. When you have walked far enough, I will tell you its name."
lost_warden.step1_floors: Goal: Clear 5 floors of the Undercroft using `/delve` — the Warden's memory grows sharper with every floor.
lost_warden.step2_meeting:
The Warden finds you in the passage, drifting like a memory between torches.

"Five floors. The dark read you, and you did not flinch."

He sits beside you, and his voice drops. "The vault guarded the First Flame — the ember from which every hearth in this village was lit. I was its warden. I was also its undoing."

"The key is held by the master of these depths. A guardian of each zone. Prove yourself against them, and the way to what I lost will open."
lost_warden.step3_boss: Goal: Defeat a zone boss in the Undercroft — the Warden's guardians answer only to strength.
lost_warden.step4_outro:
You tell the Warden of the zone master you defeated. For a long moment, he is silent.

Then he bows — a knight's bow, ancient and solemn.

"You have done what I could not in a hundred years of watching. I have no gold, no land, no name to give you. Only this: my sigil, and my word."

He presses a badge into your hands — warm, as though held by a living hand. "Wear it. Wherever the shadows close in, one of my kind will know you. My debt is paid in what little I have left."

His light flickers, then steadies — brighter than before.
lost_warden.title: The Lost Warden

arena_rival.description: The ranked arena is open. Train your pet and prove your worth.
arena_rival.step0_intro:
🏟️ A herald stops you at the arena gates, clipboard in hand.

"Your pet just unlocked **ELO ranking**! From here on, every battle counts."

He studies your pet and clicks his tongue. "But look at it — skin and bones. You can't send a starving pet into the arena. Here, a proper meal. Feed it with `!pets`, then we'll talk."

He hands you a steaming bowl of **Warrior's Stew**.
arena_rival.step1_feed: Goal: Feed your pet a real meal using `!pets`.
arena_rival.step2_feed_dialogue:
The herald watches your pet devour the stew with an approving nod.

"That's better. A fed pet is a fighting pet. But food alone won't cut it — the arena devours the weak."

He gestures at the roaring crowd behind him. "Reach **level 10** with your pet. Feed it, hunt with it, grow with it. Then we'll see if it deserves a place in the ring."
arena_rival.step3_level: Goal: Raise your pet to **level 10** — feed it, hunt with it, and it will grow stronger.
arena_rival.step4_artifact_dialogue:
The herald studies your pet, then points at the faint glow on its collar.

"There's something else every ranked fighter carries — an **artifact**. It wakes with battle, and each level grants a boost."

"Hunt, fight, or delve to awaken it, then use `/artifact` to spend the point on one of its three stats."
arena_rival.step5_artifact_level: Goal: Level up your pet's artifact — earn artifact XP by hunting, battling or delving, then check `/artifact`.
arena_rival.step6_artifact_point: Goal: Spend your artifact's stat point with `/artifact` — pick one of the three perks.
arena_rival.step7_boss:
⚔️ **Krag, the Arena Champion**
The king of the arena. No challenger has survived his roar. Defeat him with `!boss fight` and prove your pet is ready for ranked battles!
arena_rival.step8_outro:
The crowd erupts. Krag kneels, acknowledging your pet.

The herald rushes over, eyes wide. "Unbelievable! A new champion rises!"

He presses a flask into your hands. "A **Gale Draught** — the real meals, the kind champions drink. It tastes like a storm. Give it to your pet tonight."

He claps your shoulder. "Your pet is ranked now. The arena is open. Fight, win, and climb!"
arena_rival.title: The Arena Calls

world_lost_tool.description: Thorek misplaced his favourite hammer in the shafts.
world_lost_tool.title: The Lost Tool
world_lost_tool.step0_intro:
You find Thorek staring at an empty rack, jaw tight.

"My hammer. Not the fancy one — the one that fits my hand. Left it on a ledge after a bad shift. If the shafts swallowed it, I'll never hear the end of it."

He grunts. "You're heading down anyway. Keep an eye out while you `!mine`. Five swings ought to shake it loose."
world_lost_tool.step2_req: Goal: Bring **3 Iron Ore** to Thorek (gather with `!mine`, then confirm here).
world_lost_tool.step3_outro:
Thorek turns the hammer over, thumb on a familiar dent.

"That's the one. Felt wrong without it."

He tosses you a pouch for the trouble. "You mine clean. I remember that."

world_stray_seed.description: Elara found a stray seed that shouldn't have sprouted.
world_stray_seed.title: A Stray Seed
world_stray_seed.step0_intro:
Elara holds a sprout that pushed through a crack in the greenhouse glass.

"This wasn't planted. Wind, maybe — or something that wanted to be found."

She smiles. "Help me tend the beds while we figure it out. `!farm` a few crops and we'll see if it belongs."
world_stray_seed.step2_req: Goal: Bring **3 Wheat** to Elara (gather with `!farm`, then confirm here).
world_stray_seed.step3_outro:
The sprout settles, roots finding soil.

"It belongs now. You gave it neighbours."

Elara hands you a vial. "Growth elixir — for the next stray."

world_tide_gift.description: Irian asks you to read what the tide left behind.
world_tide_gift.title: A Gift from the Tide
world_tide_gift.step0_intro:
Irian crouches by a tide pool, a small bundle wrapped in kelp at her feet.

"The tide left this. Could be driftwood. Could be a message. Either way, it wants hands that know the water."

She nods at the shore. "Fish a bit — `!fish` three times — then craft one thing from what you find. The tide pays in kind."
world_tide_gift.step3_outro:
Irian unwraps the kelp — a smooth stone, warm as a held breath.

"Not driftwood. A promise the sea kept."

She presses a couple of wriggling worms into your palm. "Bait for the next promise."

quests.complete_objective_first: ⚡ Complete the current objective first (mine, farm, hunt, etc.), then use the Refresh button to check your progress!
quests.completed_activity_msg: ✅ **{title}** complete! Type `/quest` to check your progress.

daily_challenge.description: A random task given by the village to earn rewards.
daily_challenge.title: Daily Challenge

day0_welcome.step0_dialogue:
A distress signal from a forgotten colony led you to HoakHaven and its dying Zenith Generator.

GambleBot meets you at the gate. The signal was sent decades ago. You're the first to answer it. He hands you a worn journal referencing the **Strata Blueprints**, the Generator's lost schematics. The journal mentions a blacksmith named **Thorek** who knows the old mines.

"Use `!daily` to claim your stipend. Welcome."
day0_welcome.title: The Signal

day1_strata.step0_dialogue:
Thorek studies the journal in silence. His expression hardens.

"Merrik's handwriting. Council engineer. The blueprints are in a vault on Level 7 of the old mine. Nobody's been down there in decades. Tunnels are probably half collapsed."

He pulls a pickaxe off the wall and holds it out.

"Hit some rock. `!mine` a couple of times. See if the old lift shafts still hold. If they don't, we're wasting our time."
day1_strata.step2_transition:
You step out of the mine covered in dust. A woman at the docks waves you over.

"Long day underground? Come try the water. Clears the head."

She sizes you up. "No tackle on you, I bet. Rod and a tin of worms — my treat."

"Once you've got the gear, `!fish` to cast a line. Pick a spot, pick your bait, wait for a bite. Nothing to it."
day1_strata.step4_dialogue:
You pull in your catch. The woman nods.

"Not bad. You should talk to Elara next. Village gardener, spends her time near the old gardens. She found something strange out there."

She sets a small pouch of **Wheat seeds** and a vial of **Growth Elixir** on the rail beside you. "The seeds will get you through the door. The elixir, if you don't want to wait for them to grow."
day1_strata.title: Day 1: The Forge

day2_alchemy.step0_dialogue:
Elara kneels beside a circular mechanism in the garden soil. Its surface glows with faint grooves shaped like roots.

"An Alchemical Lock. Old world biotech that reads plant DNA like a key. **Wheat** is common, stable, pure. The Ancients would have used it as a baseline. Plant a couple crops with `!farm`. Let's see if the lock still listens."
day2_alchemy.step2_transition:
The mechanism hums. The grooves pulse with pale light. Elara studies a readout on her tablet.

"It's responding. But the lock wants more than plant DNA — it needs a living sample from the wild."

She points toward the treeline. "A ranger named **Irian** knows the woods. She's at the edge of town. Tell her I sent you."
day2_alchemy.step4_dialogue:
Your shovel strikes metal. You pull a small capsule from the dirt, sealed tight against time. Inside: old seeds, perfectly preserved, and a fragment of a holographic map.

Elara stares at it. "They weren't just storing power. They were storing life itself. Seeds that don't exist anywhere else."

She nods at the **Wheat** you grew. "Take it — you'll need it before this is over."

She glances at the village. "And if you want a place of your own, you'll need credits. Sell what you've gathered with `!market sell` — the village will buy almost anything."
day2_alchemy.title: Day 2: The Lock

day3_base.step0_req:
GambleBot runs the capsule data through the terminal. A partial schematic flickers onto the screen.

"Strata Blueprints, section one. Need a stationary terminal to decode the rest. Buy a Starter Shack via `!house shop`. Cost: 500 credits."
day3_base.step1_transition:
The shack terminal powers on. GambleBot's voice crackles through the speaker.

"Good. Now protect your coins. `!deposit` one time. If you lose it all gambling, at least your savings stay safe."
day3_base.step3_dialogue:
Deposit registered.

The blueprints reveal something unexpected. The Vault uses a biological lock that needs a DNA sample from local wildlife. GambleBot pauses.

"The forest outside town. There's a ranger named **Irian** who knows those woods. She's at the treeline. Don't take too long."

Irian meets you at the edge of town and holds out a **Forest Egg**, cradled in moss, warm to the touch. "A wild seed of the woods. Take it. When you're ready, `!hatch` to open it. Could be anything inside."
day3_base.title: Day 3: Home Base

day4_will.step0_dialogue:
Irian meets you at the edge of town and holds out a **Forest Egg**, cradled in moss, warm to the touch. "A wild seed of the woods. Take it."

She tilts her head toward the trees. "The Vault needs a DNA sample from local wildlife — and you'll need a companion to get one. When you're ready, `!hatch` to open it. Could be anything inside."

She sizes up the forest. "The woods aren't safe. Old experiments still run loose. So we hunt. Your pet does the fighting."
day4_will.step1_activity: Goal: `!hatch` your egg, then hunt 2 times using `!hunt`.
day4_will.step2_dialogue:
Your pet drags the DNA sample out of the brush. Irian examines it and nods. "That's what we needed."

She glances at the egg you carry. "When it hatches, feed the new one with `!pets`. A hungry pet is a dead pet."
day4_will.step3_activity: Goal: Feed your pet 1 time using `!pets`.
day4_will.step4_dialogue:
Your companion settles down after feeding. Irian watches for a moment.

"Take care of it. Whatever's ahead, you'll need something at your side."

Her radio crackles. Elara's voice comes through, urgent.

"The lock's reading is almost complete — but there's another layer buried underneath the village. Try `!dig` in the excavation pits. The Ancients buried something down there."
day4_will.title: Day 4: The Wilds

day5_odds.step0_dialogue:
GambleBot paces when you walk in.

"The Vault isn't under the Casino by accident. This building runs on risk. Every spin, every flip, every hand feeds the system."

He gestures at the machines. "Play a couple rounds. Any game. I'll watch the readings."
day5_odds.step2_transition:
The room hums. A hologram flickers to life. Its voice is flat, synthetic.

"Power levels: adequate. Market activity: verified. Community investment threshold not met. Vault access denied."

GambleBot's lights dim. "It wants us to invest in the village itself. Get everyone together. We've got one more thing to do."
day5_odds.step3_activity: Goal: Sell 1 item — open `/market` and use the **💰 Sell** view, or type `!market sell <item>`.
day5_odds.step4_dialogue:
The transaction registers. Coins clink into your account.

GambleBot nods. "Good. Credits in hand, the world opens up."

He glances at the terminal. "You've been living out of your pack. A base of operations would help — and the funds to get one are finally there."
day5_odds.title: Day 5: The Casino

day6_contribution.step0_dialogue:
The four of you gather around the hologram projector. Thorek, Elara, Irian, and GambleBot. The projection lists its demands.

"Assessment: community cohesion required. The Ancients didn't just want someone strong enough to reach the Vault. They wanted someone who could hold a community together."

Thorek grunts. "That's what the village projects are for. Check `/community` to see them. Banks, hospitals, markets. Everyone pitches in, everyone gets the bonuses."

Elara nods at you. "For the Vault, we need your contribution: **5 Iron Ore** and **3 Wheat**. Mine and farm it. Come back here when you're ready."
day6_contribution.step1_req: Goal: Contribute **5 Iron Ore** and **3 Wheat** to the community fund (gather them with `!mine` and `!farm`, then confirm here).
day6_contribution.step2_dialogue: The resources are logged. The hologram steadies. You can hear some mechanical noise, an old engine is starting.
day6_contribution.title: Day 6: Community

day7_delve.description: Find the key to the Vault.
day7_delve.step0_dialogue:
The party gathers before the Vault. Where the door should stand: a wall of black steel, seamless, sealed. A single slot glows in its center.

"Gate lock: detected. Key: absent."

Thorek grunts. "Of course there's a key. The old builders never did anything simple."

GambleBot's voice hums. "The tunnels beneath the village. The Undercroft. The Ancients stored their secrets down there. Use `/delve` to descend. Find the key."
day7_delve.step1_activity: Goal: Descend into the Undercroft with `/delve` and take the **Vault Key**.
day7_delve.step2_dialogue:
Deep in the Undercroft, in a sealed chamber older than the village, you find it: a **Vault Key**, black steel inlaid with blue light. It hums against your palm.

You climb back to the surface. The key slides into the gate's slot. Somewhere beyond, something shifts.
day7_delve.title: Day 7: The Undercroft

day8_sprout.step0_event:
The key turns. Mechanisms grind to life. The Vault door groans open.

Darkness beyond. Then a single blue eye ignites in the shadows.

An ancient combat unit stirs from centuries of sleep. Armored plating. Hydraulic limbs. It rises to its full height, its eye fixed on you.

The hologram speaks one last time:

"Guardian unit: activated. Identification: hostile. Authorization: revoked."

The machine moves forward.
day8_sprout.step1_boss: Goal: Defeat the Guardian using `!boss fight` with your active pet.
day8_sprout.step2_transition:
The Guardian hits the ground and powers down. Its blue eye fades. Across the village, lights flicker on for the first time in decades. The Generator's hum deepens, steady, alive.

Behind the Guardian's platform, the passage to the Undercroft stands open. The tunnels you descended stretch into the dark, waiting.
day8_sprout.step4_dialogue:
The hologram reappears, clearer than ever.

"Generator network: continental scale. Twelve installations detected. Active: one."

A map materializes above the Casino floor. Twelve markers. Eleven of them dark.

**--- Tutorial Complete ---**

Mines, farms, markets, fishing, dungeons are all open. The rest of the network is out there. Waiting.
day8_sprout.title: Day 8: The Vault

quests.tutorial_epilogue:
🎆 **The Signal — Tutorial Complete**

The Generator hums. The village lights stay on. The mines, farms, docks, market and the Undercroft are all open to you now.

But the map above the Casino still shows eleven dark markers. Twelve generators across the continent. Someone in this village knows more than they're letting on. Help them — their stories are the way forward.

elara.turnin_bread: Bring a warm {item} for the children at the stables
elara.turnin_wheat_b: Bring {n} {item} — the beds are waiting, and they don't forgive twice
elara.turnin_seed_b: Bring {n} {item} — she wants to try something new by the greenhouse
elara.turnin_bread_b: Bring a warm {item} — the stables' children have been asking
elara.turnin_berries: Bring a handful of {item} — a snack for the gardeners
elara.thanks1: Elara's hands are already back in the soil. "The garden will remember this, friend."
elara.thanks2: "Nature forgives, but it never forgets a kindness. Neither will I."
elara.turnin_carrot_b: Bring {n} {item} — the soil's been good to them this season
elara.turnin_berries_b: Bring a handful of {item} — the little ones keep sneaking them

thorek.turnin_loaf: Bring an {item} — even smiths need lunch
thorek.turnin_coal_b: Bring {n} {item} — the forge burns hot and fast today
thorek.turnin_iron_b: Bring {n} {item} — a delivery fell through, again
thorek.turnin_magnet: Bring a {item} — lost tools keep hiding in the shafts
thorek.turnin_nugget: Bring a {item} — he wants to test a new alloy
thorek.thanks1: Thorek grunts, satisfied. "Done right. The forge owes you one."
thorek.thanks2: "Good work. Don't let it go to your head — there's always more steel."
thorek.turnin_loaf_b: Bring an {item} — his apprentice forgot the morning rations, again
thorek.turnin_magnet_b: Bring a {item} — the deep shafts swallowed another pick
thorek.turnin_nugget_b: Bring a {item} — a customer wants something that gleams

irian.intro: "{npc} sits on the dock, line in hand. 'The sea provides, but it doesn't deliver. I need a hand with the catch.'"
irian.turnin_crayfish: Bring {n} {item} — the good bait runs out fast

mood.fog: The morning fog sits low over HoakHaven, soft and patient.
mood.generator: The Generator hums louder than usual today, like it's stretching.
mood.rain: A steady rain drums on the roofs. The village smells of wet earth and coal smoke.
mood.wind: A sharp wind sweeps the streets, rattling shutters and carrying gossip.
mood.dawn: Dawn breaks pink over the rooftops. Early risers are already moving.
mood.dusk: The lamps are lit early tonight. The village settles into its evening quiet.
mood.cold: A cold snap has crept in overnight. Breath fogs, hands stay in pockets.
mood.quiet: The streets are quiet today — the kind of quiet that means people are busy.
mood.market: The market smells of bread and curing leather. A good day for errands.
mood.stars: The stars are bright overhead, clearer than most nights.
